notes.content: The page gives a six-relation implication diagram, states which relations are orders or symmetric, and qualifies reflexivity. A slanting note rejects the claim that incidence is an order. Remark a) explains how the order and incidence determine one another through the distinguished collection and deployment. The last sentence revises its wording toward the data fixing an atelier structure and continues beyond the sheet.
math_reading_decisions: All five diagram arrows point down, with the two central implications reaching the lower-left and lower-right objects. The enclosure surrounds the middle and lower-left objects, with visible left-corner gaps.
The proposed reflexive repair literally repeats F on both sides and ends F=F. No G is supplied, although H’s note suggests one.
The last object in (1.22) is literally the collection F with a turned foot. It is not silently replaced by the ordinary F that the deployment formula might be expected to use.

(1.20) has capital Sup and dotted i in all three indexed positions; the terminal relation is a reinforced leq, not membership. The inclusion in the final equivalence is open subset, with no lower bar.
No proof, independent re-proof, or formal mathematical computation was performed. Visual comparison is recorded separately from the background statement events.
